title: How tunnels are dug
examples: What is the biggest machine used to dig tunnels?
How do engineers keep the tunnel stable after digging?
Can tunnels be dug under very deep water?

explain.say: Today we learn how engineers dig tunnels underground.
Tunnel boring machines are giant rotating cutters.
These machines chew through rock and soil very quickly.
After boring, segments are placed to support the tunnel.
Digging under rivers needs special water pressure control.
Real life example: The Thames Tunnel in London.

faq.q: Do TBMs work in all types of ground?
faq.a: TBMs are very versatile but the type used depends on the ground. Engineers must know if the ground is hard rock or soft soil first. You might ask about ground conditions, or what TBMs can handle.
asks: What kind of rock can TBMs dig through?
Are TBMs good for soft mud?

faq.q: Why do we need lining segments?
faq.a: The lining segments are like the skeleton of the tunnel. They hold the ground back immediately after the machine passes through. You could ask about tunnel support, or what keeps the tunnel from collapsing.
asks: What is the purpose of the tunnel lining?
Why can't the tunnel just be left open?

faq.q: How do they manage water pressure under rivers?
faq.a: When digging under rivers, engineers use pressurized slurry or water to match the natural water pressure. This prevents the tunnel from flooding or collapsing into the river. You could ask about water pressure, or how they seal the tunnel.
asks: What happens if the water pressure is too high?
Do they need special equipment for water?

faq.q: Are TBMs always the best way to dig?
faq.a: No, sometimes smaller methods like drill and blast are used depending on the rock type. Engineers choose the method based on a detailed survey of the geology. You might ask about alternative digging methods.
asks: Is there another way besides TBMs?
What if the rock is too hard for the machine?

faq.q: How long does it take to build a tunnel?
faq.a: The time taken depends on the length, the ground conditions, and the complexity of the project. It is a very long process that requires many stages of work. You could ask about project timelines.
asks: How many years does it take?

facts: TBMs use a rotating cutter head to excavate material.
Precast concrete segments form the initial tunnel lining.
Digging under rivers requires managing high hydrostatic pressure.
The spoil, or excavated material, must be safely removed.

quiz.say: If a tunnel passes under a deep river, what is the main danger to the diggers?

options.show: The immense pressure from the water column
options.say: The immense pressure from the water column

quiz.why: The water exerts massive pressure, which must be counteracted to keep the tunnel stable.

wrong.1: Speed is important, but it is not the primary danger under deep water.
wrong.2: The rock itself is usually manageable, but the water pressure is the critical force.
wrong.3: The machine size is designed for the job, not the source of the immediate danger.

quiz.say: What is the primary purpose of the lining segments?

options.show: To act as the main power source
options.say: To act as the main power source

options.show: To provide immediate structural support to the excavation
options.say: To provide immediate structural support to the excavation

options.show: To block out all light and noise
options.say: To block out all light and noise

quiz.why: The segments act like a temporary and permanent support ring right behind the boring head.

wrong.0: Power comes from external sources, not the lining itself.
wrong.1: They manage pressure, but they are not designed as primary water filters.
wrong.3: While they help contain the space, their main job is structural support.

quiz.say: When boring through mixed soil and rock, what must engineers consider?

options.show: Variations in material strength and water table level
options.say: Variations in material strength and water table level

options.show: Only the hardest rock type encountered
options.say: Only the hardest rock type encountered

options.show: The average depth of the tunnel only
options.say: The average depth of the tunnel only

quiz.why: Engineers must plan for changes, like going from soft clay to hard granite, and where the water sits.

wrong.1: Ignoring softer ground can lead to unexpected collapses.
wrong.2: Depth is one factor, but the type of material at that depth matters more.
wrong.3: The machine's limit is not the same as the geological limit.
